meta.scope: Mexico — first pass under new broader node definition (static + recurring citation). Focus on foundational legal instrument + core INEGI statistical system + key methodological links to international standards.

candidates.title: Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (LSNIEG)
candidates.publisher: Congreso de la Unión / Estados Unidos Mexicanos
candidates.why_qualifies: Foundational 2008 statute (with subsequent reforms) that creates the autonomous INEGI and the entire Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (SNIEG). It is the permanent legal basis for virtually all official Mexican statistics and is cited recurringly in methodology documents, publication calendars, and institutional descriptions as the source of INEGI’s mandate and of ‘Información de Interés Nacional’.

evidence_for_recurrence.citing_document: INEGI methodological and institutional materials; Official Journal publications of statistical series
evidence_for_recurrence.reference_period_or_equivalent: Continuous / every statistical programme and calendar of Información de Interés Nacional references the Law as its legal foundation
evidence_for_recurrence.quote_or_location: Ley publicada DOF 16-04-2008; última reforma DOF 14-11-2025. Article 1 and subsequent provisions establish INEGI and the SNIEG as the framework for all Information of National Interest.

evidence_for_recurrence.reference_period_or_equivalent: The transfer of price indices from Banco de México to INEGI in 2011 is explicitly grounded in the LSNIEG
evidence_for_recurrence.quote_or_location: With the entry into force of the Law of the National System of Statistical and Geographical Information, the exclusive power for the elaboration of these macroeconomic indicators was granted to INEGI...

proposed_edges.basis: Legal authority for INEGI to produce the CPI transferred by the LSNIEG
National accounts form part of the Información de Interés Nacional defined and regulated by the Law

candidates.notes: Classic example of the new rule. A single (reformed) statute that is load-bearing for the entire statistical system and is cited on an ongoing basis. No independent publication cadence of its own.

candidates.title: Índice Nacional de Precios al Consumidor (INPC) / Consumer Price Index
candidates.why_qualifies: Core inflation measure. Published twice monthly (10th and 25th) in the Official Journal. Basket and weights updated periodically (most recent major update 2024 based on ENIGH 2022) while maintaining the 2nd half of July 2018 base.

proposed_edges.basis: Legal mandate transferred to INEGI by the LSNIEG (effective July 2011)

candidates.notes: High-frequency, high-authority series. Strong candidate for authority ranking once edges are in place.

candidates.title: Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México (SCNM) / System of National Accounts of Mexico
candidates.why_qualifies: Mexico’s national accounts system (annual + quarterly + monthly indicators). Explicitly follows SNA 2008. Includes Supply and Use Tables, institutional sector accounts, and multiple satellite accounts. Base year currently 2018 for many series (previous major bases 2013 and 2008).

proposed_edges.basis: Methodology documents state adoption and adaptation of the 2008 System of National Accounts
National accounts form part of Información de Interés Nacional under the LSNIEG

candidates.notes: Central macroeconomic framework. Strong links both to the domestic legal foundation and to the international SNA 2008 standard.

candidates.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
candidates.why_qualifies: Decennial population and housing census (years ending in 0). Most complete demographic and social data source. Intermediate counts / intercensal surveys also exist historically.

proposed_edges.basis: Population statistics are core Información de Interés Nacional under the Law

candidates.notes: Classic high-authority, low-frequency node. Fractional releases_per_year = 0.1.

candidates.title: Censos Económicos / Economic Censuses
candidates.why_qualifies: Conducted every five years. Comprehensive data on economic units across most sectors. Major input into national accounts benchmarks and many other series.

proposed_edges.basis: Economic Censuses provide the detailed structural data used for national accounts benchmarks and base-year changes
proposed_edges.reference_period: every five years / at each base-year revision

candidates.notes: Key structural input. Strong candidate for edges into SCNM.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional de Ocupación y Empleo (ENOE) / National Survey of Occupation and Employment
candidates.why_qualifies: Primary labour-force survey. Quarterly results. Used both for labour statistics and as an input into informal-sector estimates in the national accounts.

proposed_edges.basis: IMF ROSC notes use of ENOE (together with Economic Censuses) for informal-sector measurement in the SCNM

candidates.notes: Core labour series with documented downstream use in national accounts.
